en: Black‑and‑white view of a vast Neo‑Gothic hall with high ribbed vaults, richly decorated ribs and arches, and a largely empty polished floor. Around the perimeter stand large statues of armored figures on pedestals, Gothic arches with tracery, mural paintings on the walls, and rows of wooden chairs. The composition looks like a grand ceremonial hall in a historic European city hall or castle.
